nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of allowances; written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Public minimum supply threshold that gates the burn-on-transfer logic.
Public burn percentage (2) applied on every transfer while supply is above the minimum.
Private LP address; when equal to the recipient, transfer/transferFrom silently return false (transfer blacklist / honeypot gate).
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner access control check.
Public ERC20 transfer; blocked (returns false) when _lp equals the recipient.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; blocked when _lp equals the recipient, otherwise moves tokens and reduces allowance.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Admin-only function that assigns the _lp blacklist address.
Internal transfer routine applying burn rate and updating balances.
Internal burn routine reducing balance and total supply.
Internal mint routine increasing balance and total supply.
Internal allowance writer used by approve, transferFrom and the allowance helpers.
AccessControl role granting; caller must hold the role's admin role.
Ownable ownership transfer; restricted to the current owner by onlyOwner.
CMERC20Snapshot entry point; requires SNAPSHOT_ROLE before creating a snapshot.
Context helper returning msg.sender; source of caller identity across the contract.
External caller identity used for access control, approvals and transfer ownership.
amount.mul(BURN_RATE).div(PERCENTS_DIVIDER) burn amount computation inside _transfer.
Subtraction of the transferred value from the sender balance in _transfer.
Privileged require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender())) gate guarding setLP.
Allowance subtraction in transferFrom decrementing the caller allowance.
Destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom; compared against _lp.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Token amount parameter used across transfer, transferFrom, approve and burn math.
Local variable holding the value left after the burn fee is deducted in _transfer.
Local variable holding the computed burn fee in _transfer.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the new owner address.
Account parameter used by _mint, _burn, grantRole and burnFrom.

edges.reason: _msgSender() supplies the caller address used as the transfer sender.
_msgSender() feeds the hasRole check that gates setLP.
_msgSender() feeds the admin role requirement inside grantRole.
msg.sender is validated against DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE before _lp can be reassigned.
The role check controls whether setLP executes.
setLP writes the privileged _lp address.
msg.sender is the untrusted source of the transfer call.
msg.sender is the untrusted source of the transferFrom call and allowance spender.
recipient is compared with _lp and forwarded into _transfer.
amount is the value forwarded into _transfer.
_lp gates transfer, silently returning false for the blacklisted address.
_lp gates transferFrom, silently returning false for the blacklisted address.
recipient is compared with _lp and passed to _transfer.
sender is the debited account in transferFrom.
amount is the debited value in transferFrom.
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance update to _transfer.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
Current allowance is read and reduced during transferFrom.
amount is subtracted from the allowance.
The reduced allowance value flows into _approve.
recipient receives the credited balance in _transfer.
sender balance is debited in _transfer.
amount drives the burn computation and balance updates in _transfer.
_minimumSupply gates whether the burn fee is applied on transfer.
BURN_RATE gates and scales the burn fee inside _transfer.
_totalSupply determines whether the burn branch is taken.
amount is multiplied and divided to compute the burn fee.
BURN_RATE and PERCENTS_DIVIDER scale the burn amount arithmetic.
burnAmount is the result of the unsafe burn arithmetic.
Sender balance is read before being decreased.
remainingAmount is subtracted from the sender balance.
The reduced balance is written back inside _transfer.
_transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances.
The computed burn amount is passed to _burn.
_burn decreases the account balance.
_burn decreases the total supply.
_mint increases the account balance.
_mint increases the total supply.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve delegates to _approve.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
grantRole verifies msg.sender holds the admin role.
transferOwnership is restricted to the stored _owner via onlyOwner.
newOwner is the untrusted parameter that becomes the new _owner.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged _owner slot.
snapshot checks msg.sender against SNAPSHOT_ROLE.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a non-core parameter consumed only by the transfer function's _lp comparison and balance credit.
sender is a non-core parameter consumed only by transferFrom to identify the debited account.
amount is a non-core parameter whose value is applied inside the core _transfer balance and burn logic.
remainingAmount is a local variable that only exists to feed the balance subtraction operation.
burnAmount is a local variable that only holds the output of the burn fee arithmetic.
newOwner is a non-core parameter used exclusively to rewrite the privileged _owner state.
account is a non-core parameter consumed by _burn (and the related mint/burn entry points) to target the balance slot.
